name: Burgoo
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 pound (450 g) mixed cooked meats (beef, lamb, pork, chicken, game, etc.)

steps: Combine all ingredients in a pot, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours, skimming the top as needed.

culture.text: Burgoo is a stew, similar to Irish or Mulligan stew, often served with cornbread or corn muffins, one form of which originated in Kentucky. It is often prepared communally as a social gathering. It is popular as the basis for civic fundraisers in the Upland South.
